brief:
Israeli occupation forces demolished Al-Barqi commercial structures on Monday while expanding the "yellow line"—a restricted zone established by Israeli forces in Gaza—near the Happy City resort in the Qizzan al-Najjar area south of Khan Younis, according to field sources reported by Shehab Wire. The operations targeted commercial facilities in the southern Gaza city.

The yellow line has restricted Palestinian movement and access to land in multiple areas of Gaza. Monday's expansion marks the latest in a series of demolitions and territorial restrictions imposed by Israeli forces in the Khan Younis governorate, where conflict has intensified in recent months.
title: Israeli forces demolish structures, expand yellow line south of Khan Younis
